lines.x: 博士，资料整理好了，样品送到实验室了，信息也全部录入终端了。呃，好像暂时没有你能做的事了……不如来聊聊天吧。

When I first stepped out into the barrens, the strangest thing was the silence. Once all the household gossip vanished from my ears, I realized how interesting the sound of wind over sand could be. But after listening long enough, I start missing that lived-in racket back home. Wanting it all—people really are greedy, aren't we?

Ever since I became an Operator, my travel plan has gotten so long. Luckily, plenty of the destinations already have little checkmarks on them. What's left? Visit the museums in Sargon, taste the food in Yan, watch the chariot races in Minos—could Great Geyser Town move that far, I wonder? M-maybe it could move there too! Mm!
隔一段时间就有几十封信从大涌泉镇寄过来，我的宿舍都快放不下了……回信？那倒不用担心，我会把回复都写在一封信里寄回去，给所有人传阅。大涌泉镇就是这样没有秘密的地方啦。

People used to worry I'd get bullied, so they arranged everything for me. After a while, I really did start believing I couldn't do anything myself. Now? Now I'm the most well-traveled person in the whole town—my relatives even write asking me for trip advice!

I used to think I'd never catch up to Grandma's footsteps. It was only after I set out that I realized: I couldn't learn a single one of her Arts, but what made everyone trust her wasn't Arts, it was her kindness and her nerve. Besides, I'm only eighteen. Grandma was a bit clumsy at eighteen too!

Do you ever feel this way, Doctor? Love is sometimes like looking at something when you're farsighted. It comes from caring, but up close it's all a mess, and only once you're apart does everything come clear. Mm, space from each other matters too, doesn't it?
左左右左右右……坐在接线室里被琐事淹没，难以消化自己的情绪时，我总是用脚打拍子来缓解焦虑和疲劳——博士也来配合我了？那好，我可要加速咯！
以前没有人相信我会是那个领着大家前进的人，连我自己都怀疑，走进那片荒野，为所有人开拓新家园，真的是我能做到的吗？但……故事不都是这样开始的嘛。
Have some carrot soup, Doctor. Rest properly—that's how you get the strength to go somewhere farther.
博士，我听说在罗德岛工作有机会去好多不一样的地方出外勤，探索各种各样的——先接受治疗？好、好的……我会记得递交入职申请的——
You mean, if I just keep up my training, I can become like this?
我知道我看起来胆小又不厉害，也清楚人事部的建议。但比起内勤，我还是想更多地参与外勤工作。既然你认可了我的工作，也请……认可我的决心！
风景不只存在于去过的那些地方，更关乎旅途中邂逅的人和经历的事。当我不再着急出门，整片大地都向我敞开了……真奇妙啊。
A field survey? I want to go! I promise I'll be careful!
I'll do everything I can not to hold everyone back—uh, I mean, to lead everyone forward!
指南针、地图、水壶、登山杖……稍等一下，马上就清点好了！
D-don't think I'm scared of you!
Ready to move out anytime! Wow, I actually said it. That was kind of cool.
Once it's decided, we see it through.
Stomp every hardship flat!
Kick every hesitation aside!
Chili peppers aren't just for seasoning, ssss—
Gas canisters aren't just for cooking, bang!
Trekking poles aren't just for support, hah!
背包可不只是用来装东西的，还可以把你装——呜，装不下呀……
谢谢你带我看到更美的风景，博士。这份触动……就是旅行的意义吧。
This survey operation—success! I'll get the photos and the data organized. But first, Doctor, say chee—se!
Out in the field, luck matters as much as courage. We got through almost all our survey objectives, so our luck was pretty good.
The tent, the tent's about to blow away! What did I even do wrong—
Time to draw up an exploration map of Rhodes Island.
Awawa!
You can't do without me, right~? Where do you need a hand?
Arknights.
烟花太吵我把耳朵塞住了——你刚刚说什么？实在吃不下了？雷姆必拓人就是这么热情好客的啦……坚持住，我看厨房里还没消停呢！
Here, a little flower from the barrens. I had a feeling you'd like it.

Doctor, this is a carrot cake I made from my family's recipe. It's really good. You can make a wish before you blow out the candles. Shh, don't say it out loud. A real wish is one you tell only to yourself, in your heart.
博士，这是妈妈寄给你的馅饼。他们当然知道你。我离家那么远，家里人到底还是担心，但了解了我在这里的生活后，他们不仅没来信反对，还给我提到的每个人都寄了馅饼，嘿嘿……
